title: Python: /presence/cache GET (all known nodes)
description: Return cached presence for all known nodes
close_reason: Implemented PresenceCacheResource with GET /presence/cache returning CBOR {nodes: [{addr, status, age_s, battery?}...]} matching Rust wire format. Added PresenceStatus enum (available/busy/away/offline/emergency), update/remove/purge_older_than methods, and 12 tests.
